remarks:
LOCATION! Discover the potential of this approximately 51-acre parcel located on Bakerstand Rd in Machias.  This property offers a network of existing trails throughout, making it easy to explore all it has to offer. The land is fully wooded with a mix of ash, maple, and cherry, along with abundant natural cover from tree tops.

A stream runs through the property near the road, adding to the natural beauty and character of the land. The terrain features clay loam soil with a hilly landscape and moderate to steep slopes, providing scenic views of the surrounding countryside.

Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts, this property offers excellent hunting opportunities with abundant wildlife including deer, turkey, goose, and fox. Surrounded by larger parcels owned by long-term neighbors, this location offers both privacy and a peaceful setting.

Conveniently located just a short distance to Ellicottville, Franklinville, and Machias, you can enjoy the perfect balance of seclusion and accessibility. This parcel is being subdivided from a larger parcel, with additional acreage available if desired. UP TO 70 ACRES CAN BE AVAILABLE.
